description: Millat Tractors Limited was incorporated in June 1964 and is engaged in the assembly and manufacturing of agricultural tractors, implements and multi-application products. Its group companies, as described on its own site, include Millat Industrial Products Limited, a subsidiary engaged in manufacturing and selling vehicular, industrial and domestic batteries; Bolan Castings Limited, whose management control the company acquired in 1993 by purchasing 51% of the shares offered under privatisation; and TIPEG Intertrade DMCC in Dubai, the group's trading arm responsible for the export function of the group companies.
